description: Alias of mold_parting for side actions. on true, or omit on, opens the core and cavity colouring and returns the same block list and counts (slides, lifters, unresolved undercuts), each with its withdraw direction and face area. replacedBy is mold_parting. on false does not hide that colouring; the message names mold_parting { on: false }. A wall within 0.5° of vertical is not a side action. The withdraw direction is never the pull axis. group highlights one block. Read-only. Not mold CAD and not a quote. Molding rules: guide { topic: "molding" }. Long runs: an analysis still going after about 30 s answers { status: "running", stillRunning: true, jobId, command, phase?, percent?, elapsedSec, etaSec? } instead of the result. That is a heartbeat, not the result. Call mold_status { job_id } (it waits up to about 30 s each time) until it answers the result; the analysis keeps running in the tab and is not restarted.

group.description: Side-action group id to highlight, forwarded to mold_parting.

on.description: true, or omit, opens core and cavity and returns the side actions. false does not hide them. Call mold_parting { on: false } to hide that colouring.

name: mold_side_actions
